products.h1: Fire Safety Storage Cabinet - Type 90 (SC3-90F Series)
products.subhead: EN 14470-1 certified 90-minute fire protection for flammable hazardous materials
products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) SC3-90F Series Fire Safety Storage Cabinets (Type 90) safeguard flammable hazardous materials from fire, with proven refractory performance certified to the strictest European standard, EN 14470-1.
features: High Fire Resistance: Fire resistance performance is in accordance with the strictest European standard (EN 14470-1), with the internal temperature kept below a 180 K rise for up to 90 minutes in the event of fire.

Fire Response Sealing System: When the temperature reaches 50 C the door automatically closes, and when the ambient temperature reaches 70 +/- 10 C the exhaust holes and ventilation openings automatically close, totally blocking the flow of heat from outside.

Application-Matched Model Selection: The right model can be selected to suppress fire at the natural ignition point of the dangerous goods being handled, considering prediction time and other factors.
Chemical-Resistant Interior: The interior material is coated with polyphenol resin for excellent chemical resistance, even in long-term use.
Triple Insulation Structure: All walls use the same triple-insulated structure, and all gaps are treated with fire-retardant finishes to protect flammable materials in a surrounding fire.

Safe Ventilation of Flammable Vapour: Vent inlet and outlet openings discharge gas easily to prevent accidents from accumulated flammable vapour and protect the operator, keeping vapours below the LEL concentration.
Solid, Secure Shelving: A solid shelf structure holds up to 80 kg per shelf and fixes firmly to the inside walls, with 30 mm-deep shelf edges to safely retain any leaked contents.

Effluent Reservoir and Key Lock: A bottom collecting sump safely handles any leaked material and prevents leakage out of the cabinet, and a key lock is provided as standard to block unauthorised access.
Easy Movement and Installation: Forklift fork space allows convenient movement, and leveling feet provide stable installation; under-bench models offer selectable 750 mm or 820 mm working height.

products.subhead: EN 14470-1 certified 30-minute fire protection for flammable hazardous materials
products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) SC3-30F Series Fire Safety Storage Cabinets (Type 30) safeguard flammable hazardous materials from fire, with proven refractory performance certified to the strictest European standard, EN 14470-1.
features: High Fire Resistance: Fire resistance performance is in accordance with the strictest European standard (EN 14470-1), with the internal temperature kept below a 180 K rise for up to 30 minutes in the event of fire.

Fire Response Sealing System: When the temperature reaches 50 C the door automatically closes, and when the ambient temperature reaches 70 +/- 10 C the exhaust holes and ventilation openings automatically close, totally blocking the flow of heat from outside.

Application-Matched Model Selection: The right model can be selected to suppress fire at the natural ignition point of the dangerous goods being handled, considering prediction time and other factors.
Chemical-Resistant Interior: The interior material is coated with polyphenol resin for excellent chemical resistance, even in long-term use.
Triple Insulation Structure: All walls use the same triple-insulated structure, and all gaps are treated with fire-retardant finishes to protect flammable materials in a surrounding fire.

Safe Ventilation of Flammable Vapour: Vent inlet and outlet openings discharge gas easily to prevent accidents from accumulated flammable vapour and protect the operator, keeping vapours below the LEL concentration.
Solid, Secure Shelving: A solid shelf structure holds up to 80 kg per shelf and fixes firmly to the inside walls, with 30 mm-deep shelf edges to safely retain any leaked contents.

Effluent Reservoir and Key Lock: A bottom collecting sump safely handles any leaked material and prevents leakage out of the cabinet, and a key lock is provided as standard to block unauthorised access.
Easy Movement and Installation: Forklift fork space allows convenient movement, and leveling feet provide stable installation; under-bench models offer selectable 750 mm or 820 mm working height.

products.subhead: Ductless, filtered reagent storage for a clean lab environment - no exhaust system needed
products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) FSC Series Filtering Storage Cabinets store reagents in a ductless, recirculating-filtration cabinet, keeping the laboratory environment clean without connecting to an existing exhaust system.
features: Cost-Effective Ductless Filtration: Flexible installation is possible with no cost-intensive exhaust air ducts, and internal air circulation prevents the heating and cooling loss - and high energy consumption - of ducted exhaust.

Customised Filter Configuration: An ISO class 4 (US class 10) HEPA filter removes 0.3 um and larger particulates at 99.99% efficiency; a polyester pre-filter (85% arrestance) traps larger particles and extends HEPA life; and VOC, MA and MB activated-carbon filters are available - selected to suit the chemicals used.
Real-Time VOC Indication: A clear, symbolic VOC level bar indicates the VOC measurement inside the cabinet, with real-time detecting and displaying via an internal VOC sensor.

Powerful Air Purification (Turbo Fan): A turbo-fan button activates the fan at maximum speed before the door is opened, protecting users from any remaining hazardous gas; this can also be interlocked with door opening.

Safety Alarms and Protection: Safety warning alarms with LED indicators cover high temperature (with automatic fan stop), fan failure, door open, sensor error and check-filter, plus over-temperature and over-current protection.

Energy-Saving Sleep Mode: A sleep mode (for example, running only 8 am to 6 pm) saves up to 60% of energy consumption and extends the life of the fan and filter, and auto run resumes automatically after a power failure.

SEFA-Tested, Durable Storage: Doors and drawers are tested to SEFA (door-hinge and drawer static-load tests), with an additional overturning test, and drawers sustain up to 40 kg on smooth full-extension slides.

Chemical-Resistant Build: Corrosion-resistant epoxy-coated steel throughout and a tempered-glass door give clear observation, a full-length handle, a spill tray and a door lock for clean, safe storage.
